title: Actually: Shakespeare Wasn't Shakespeare?
description: Authorship rumors and stage lore—what’s myth vs. evidence?

questions.question: Myth: Shakespeare dreamed up his love stories. Which of his tragedies retells Arthur Brooke's 1562 poem about two doomed Italian lovers?
Romeo and Juliet wasn't original—roughly how many of Shakespeare's plots were wholly his own invention?
With almost none of his plots original, how many spellings of Shakespeare's name exist?
Over 80 name spellings later—who likely co-wrote Shakespeare's later plays?
John Fletcher may have helped—but what's the highest education Shakespeare likely received?

imageHint: A quill pen forming a question mark - questioning the very authorship of the Bard
